item.title: Another Grantham shop bites the dust
item.description: Lyn Harding says… I don’t walk out of Morrisons centre too often but was saddened to see yet another shop going – the shoe store, Shoezone. This poor town is becoming a ghost town unless you like coffee, vaping, charity, barbers. So sad. The post Another Grantham shop bites the dust appeared first on Grantham Matters.
